conditional_64: only within predicted 4GiB GPU/8GiB host budgets
seed_rule: 125000+U; one engineering development instance per size
failure_policy: No increased budgets or tuned reruns; report timeouts, infeasibility and absent incumbents
timing_contract: One explicit kernel warmup; CPU/GPU vectorized coefficient builds; transfer separated; CPU solver setup separated. GPU PDHG iteration time includes checks. Communication and per-solver budgets matched, not an equal end-to-end runtime claim.
minimum_power_target: 0.95*valid fixed-power MILP incumbent throughput; skip if no such incumbent
GPU_algorithm: FP64 PDHG, no CPU-dual warm start, P-T only
clock_limit_check: At each check; overshoot by one 200-iteration block possible and reported
scope: Known CSI solver engineering pilot; not an operational channel estimation experiment or SOTA comparison
